name: pumi-browser
description: A web page in a tab: back, forward, reload and an address bar over the app's webview, and where cmd+click opens a terminal's links. Turn it off and browser tabs, their commands and their settings go; links open in the system's browser.

url.label: Page
url.desc: The page's address in this tab. Setting it navigates.

home_url.label: Home page
home_url.desc: The page a new browser tab opens. Leave empty to start in the address bar.

search_url.label: Search
search_url.desc: The search engine the address bar uses; {query} stands for what you typed.

open_links.label: Open links in
open_links.desc: Where cmd+click opens links from terminals: a browser tab beside the terminal, or the system's browser. Shift+cmd+click opens the other.

webview_devtools.label: Web Inspector
webview_devtools.desc: Inspect and debug web pages with alt+cmd+i.

commands.title: Browser: open a page in a new view
